_README.purpose: Reusable base-ingredient macro reference. Values are ballpark estimates from standard UK nutritional data, tuned for reduced-fat/fat-free products common in slimming cookbooks.
_README.fields: per = [kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, satFat_g] for the stated basis; avg_g = typical weight of one item when a recipe gives a count without grams; g100 = optional per-100g fallback used when a normally-counted item is given by weight.
_README.usage: Parse quantity+unit from an ingredient line, map to the base name here, scale per by the parsed amount. See https://recipills.github.io/README.md
